window-1.title: WigglyPaint
window-1.blurb: Every line you draw squirms and squeaks like it's alive, and you can export the whole wobbly mess as a GIF — it's the most charmingly imperfect drawing tool on the internet and I fully expect to see it in your next persona shoot's title cards.

window-2.title: Colossal
window-2.blurb: It's a daily drip of people who went way too far on a handmade idea — thread portraits, stop-motion obsessives, clay worlds — and you'll come away with three new side quests before lunch.

window-3.title: Calamansi Sparkling Margarita Mocktail
window-3.blurb: A margarita rerouted through calamansi — that auntie-kitchen citrus you already know by heart — salted rim and all, and endlessly riffable with a chilli-salt rim or a float of pandan syrup.

window-4.title: This Eclectic, Treasure-Filled Apartment Is Maximalism Done Right
window-4.blurb: A recovering minimalist turned full trinket-maximalist who furnished her whole character-filled apartment through Craigslist finds and sheer love of stuff — basically your interiors side quest, already in progress.

window-5.title: Cookboys, I12 Katong
window-5.blurb: It's a whole 1970s Hainanese cookboy universe built out in vintage signboards and old shopfronts — basically a persona shoot you can order kopi in, and I need you to photograph the signage before anyone else does.
